refero:9972.summary: From week calendar, staff clicks a cell, fills client + provider + multiple services in a side panel (end time auto-sums), confirms with notify, and sees one block with 3 services and room.
steps: Empty week calendar; provider filter Liam; Add
New appointment drawer (date/time, client, provider, Add services)
Client search list + Add New Client
Services picker with duration, price, end buffer
Stacked service cards; end time calculated; calendar preview blocks
Book appointment confirm modal + notify checkbox
Confirm Book it with notify on
Booked block: John Doe, 3 services, Nail Room #1, buffer hatch
steal: Click calendar cell → side drawer prefilled start time (shortest path) — steps 1–2
Single form: person + provider + multi-service Add+; end time derived from sum — steps 2, 5–6
Per-service duration + "10m block at the end" buffer and room on card — steps 4–6
Confirm modal with "Notify client via email and text" before commit — steps 7–8
avoid: One client per appointment only — no group/capacity roster for 4–10 learners in one slot
refero:9972.fit: Best proxy for simple-events: scenario(s)+room+faculty+learner from a calendar cell; multi-service ≈ multi-station rotation in one booking; extend with group capacity.
